list: The official 55 trophies, as published 18 Nov 2026
listNote: Names, descriptions and grades are PlayStation's official text, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles on 18 Nov 2026 and reported by Push Square. Counts (42 Shooting Range challenges, 14 drone race locations, 18 meditation spots, 52 areas, 9 gangs, 8 garages) are the counts PlayStation tracks for those trophies. Hidden flags follow the 28 hidden trophies listed by Output Lag on 19 Nov 2026. GTA VI launches 19 Nov 2026; where a step is not yet confirmed in-game, the guide says so instead of guessing.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The Platinum pops the moment the other 54 are done — there is nothing extra to do. Use this guide's roadmap as the order and the checklist as the record; when the last bronze, silver or gold lands, this one follows automatically.
steps: Finish the other 54 trophies in any order.
Use the roadmap stages to avoid the one missable trophy.
100% completion (A Long Road) is usually the last step.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missableNote: A one-off setup — save before you try it; a failed attempt means re-planning the approach.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. At Vice City International Airport, steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge — the planes at gates E3 and E4 work; planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. Go up to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off. Fly about 1 km away from the airport and it pops. Save first, because the police come fast.
steps: Go to VCIA, gates E3 or E4.
Steal the docked passenger plane and take off.
Fly about 1 km from the airport.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.missableNote: Needs the Snap Gun from a Chapter 3 mission — do the robbery undetected; if spotted, reload the save.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies. Go to a store's locked back door and use the Snap Gun on it — kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target. If someone spots you, reload rather than push on.
steps: Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 to get the Snap Gun.
Use the Snap Gun on a jewelry store's locked back door.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Bank vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4. Tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. You cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner. Vault jobs give you a 4-star wanted level straight away, so escaping one with your partner also earns Hot Together. 100% needs all eight vaults.
steps: Do That's Where The Money Is near the end of Chapter 4.
Rob 5 vaults with your partner and escape each time.

roadmap.title: Story first — Chapters 1 to 4 and the finale
roadmap.advice: Play the story straight through, but keep a manual save at the start of every chapter. Do Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 before the chapter ends — it is the one reported missable. Do not start the final mission until stages 2 and 3 are done.

roadmap.title: Strangers and side characters
roadmap.advice: Clear the five side-character finales, the 8 stranger strands and Bret's hunt before the finale. Start each strand the moment its marker appears, and race Yago the moment the hourglass shows in Chapter 3.

roadmap.title: Activities and skills
roadmap.advice: Try all 9 activity types once, win the drone races and the 20 races, beat Cal at fishing, and work on the 250 stunts and the 42 gold Shooting Range challenges. This is the longest skill stage — start it early and chip at it between story missions.

roadmap.title: Collectibles and exploration
roadmap.advice: Meditate at all 18 spots with your partner along, finish 3 card sets, WAiNK It at 100 locations, discover 100 vehicles and explore all 52 areas. Sweep the map region by region so nothing is left behind.

roadmap.title: Heists, combat and the wanted level
roadmap.advice: The robbery tools arrive in Chapters 3 and 4. Do the partner trophies while Jason and Lucia are together, bring your partner to every vault, and keep a getaway car ready for every robbery.

roadmap.title: Money, secrets and the Platinum
roadmap.advice: Launder $250,000, spend $100,000, buy all 8 garages and register 10 vehicles, then let the choice counter and the strange-event trophies finish. 100% completion pops A Long Road, and the Platinum follows.
